item.title: 🔵 WP Maps Pro bug exploited to create admin accounts on WordPress sites
item.description:
Why this matters: Could impact sign-ins/MFA/Conditional Access — watch for login issues.
Hackers are targeting WordPress websites running a vulnerable version of the WP Maps Pro plugin, which allows creating rogue administrator accounts without authentication. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 9h ago
